preconditions: Confirm controller/sensor references and electrical compatibility
Measure tare and known masses using calibration.py
Confirm DataMatrix reader and network/TLS/GATT configuration

cases.name: nominal withdrawal
steps: Register actual batch and unit mass
Scan DataMatrix and remove one unit
Read stock and movement history from phone
cases.expected: quantity decreases once; one correlated movement

cases.name: duplicate/reconnect
steps: Restore link and replay same IDs
cases.expected: no loss of unacknowledged event; one business effect

cases.name: thermal and failure
steps: Inject configured temperatures around each boundary
cases.expected: document hysteresis and physical fan output; explicit sensor failure
